mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record_out ( CUSTOMER_ID,PRODUCT_ID,RECORD_OUT_NUMBER, RECORD_OUT_TIME,USER_ID,REPO_ID, REMARKS,CREATE_TIME,IS_DELETE ) VALUES ( #{customerId},#{productId},#{recordOutNumber}, #{recordOutTime},#{userId},#{repoId}, #{remarks},#{createTime},#{isDelete} )
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(bb.count,0) AS "count",aa.date AS "time" FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(@cdate := DATE_ADD(@cdate,INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%Y-%m') AS DATE FROM (SELECT @cdate := DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) FROM record_out) a LIMIT 12) aa LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(record_out_number) AS COUNT,DATE_FORMAT(record_out_time,'%Y-%m') AS mon FROM record_out GROUP BY mon) bb ON aa.date=bb.mon ORDER BY aa.date ASC
SELECT product_id,sum(record_out_number) AS 'count' FROM record_out WHERE record_out_time >= #{startTime} AND record_out_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY product_id
